svg.title: COAST architecture
svg.desc: Inputs (LiDAR returns and sensor origin, current state and goal, velocity and acceleration limits, vehicle radius) feed a voxel map, then an A* and Safe Flight Corridor front end, then a minimum-snap quadratic program with MINVO bounds, producing B-spline control points. The multirotor flies the trajectory and the planner re-plans with each new scan. A separate panel lists the main tunable parameters and their defaults. A QR code links to github.com/byu-magicc/coast.
svg.text: Multirotor tracks the spline · new scan → re-plan at 10 Hz
Tunable parametersFrontEndConfig defaults; every field is in docs/configuration.md
